title: CLI Model Serving Tool
summary: This module provides a command-line interface for serving Hugging Face models via an HTTP API, supporting features like continuous batching, quantization, and various generation tasks.

nodes.label: Start CLI Server
nodes.title: Serve CLI Entrypoint
nodes.description: The main entry point for the CLI server, responsible for parsing arguments and orchestrating the server setup.

nodes.label: Manage Model Lifecycle
nodes.title: Model Manager
nodes.description: Handles loading, unloading, and caching of Hugging Face models based on requests and idle timeouts.

nodes.label: Handle Chat Completions
nodes.title: Chat Completion Handler
nodes.description: Processes incoming chat completion requests, applies chat templates, and generates responses using loaded models.

nodes.label: Handle Text Completions
nodes.title: Completion Handler
nodes.description: Manages standard text completion requests, generating continuations based on provided prompts.

nodes.label: Handle General Responses
nodes.title: Response Handler
nodes.description: A general-purpose handler for various response generation tasks, leveraging model capabilities.

nodes.label: Handle Audio Transcription
nodes.title: Transcription Handler
nodes.description: Processes audio input to perform speech-to-text transcription using appropriate models.

nodes.label: Run HTTP API Server
nodes.title: Uvicorn HTTP Server
nodes.description: The FastAPI/Uvicorn server that exposes the model serving API endpoints to external clients.

nodes.label: Configure Continuous Batching
nodes.title: Continuous Batching Config
nodes.description: Defines parameters for continuous batching, such as KV cache block size and memory limits, to optimize inference throughput.

nodes.label: Manage Generation Settings
nodes.title: Generation State
nodes.description: Holds global generation parameters like continuous batching enablement, torch.compile status, and other inference optimizations.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Model
nodes.title: External Hugging Face Model
nodes.description: Represents a pre-trained model from the Hugging Face ecosystem, loaded and managed by the ModelManager for inference.

nodes.label: External Client
nodes.title: External API Client
nodes.description: An external application or user interacting with the model serving API via HTTP requests.
